evidence.claim: The red comes from oxidized iron in deposits laid down during the Permian Period.

evidence.quote: The dissolution of underlying gypsum beds has led to the formation of sinkholes which are common features within the Red Hills region.

The Comanche County Courthouse in Coldwater, Kansas was built in 1927.  It was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 2002.

evidence.claim: Carrie Nation lived in this small brick house on Fowler Avenue from 1889 to 1902.
evidence.quote: Carrie Nation lived in this small brick house, at 211 W. Fowler Ave. (US 160), at the corner with Oak Street, in Medicine Lodge, from 1889 to 1902.

evidence.quote: Carrie Nation began her temperance work in Medicine Lodge by starting a local branch of the Woman's Christian Temperance Union and campaigning for the enforcement of Kansas' ban on the sale of liquor.
